newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle moderate at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle moderate at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.
Sales reported on 6,400 slaughter steers and 4,700 heifers; 63,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 16,200 formulated cattle and 200 contracts to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 70.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 70.00.
